simple.summary: בַּתָּה (battâh) means desolation First listed occurrence: Isa 7 19.

definitions.full: H1327. battah [ בַּתָּה ] noun feminine precipice, steep (as cut off, abrupt ) — הַבַּתּוֺת בְּנַחֲלֵי Isa 7:9 in the ravines of the precipices .
definitions.rootNote: feminine from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces);
